responsibility: Implements the -Wmisleading-indentation warning for C-family front ends. It reconstructs visual columns from source text with tab handling, compares the indentation of a guard statement, its controlled body, and the following statement, filters out cases obscured by line directives, macros, or intervening unindentation, and emits the paired warning/inform diagnostics when layout misleadingly suggests incorrect control-flow nesting.
same_name_distinction: Warning implementation for misleading indentation: unlike c-indentation.h, which only provides the token_indent_info abstraction and function declarations, this file performs source-line column reconstruction, heuristic filtering, and emission of -Wmisleading-indentation diagnostics.
